026
027import java.lang.reflect.*;

029import java.util.function.*;

031import org.apache.juneau.bean.swagger.Swagger;
032import org.apache.juneau.commons.*;

062/**
063 * A single session of generating a Swagger document.
064 *
065 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
066 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauBeanSwagger2">juneau-bean-swagger-v2</a>
067 * </ul>
068 */
069@SuppressWarnings({
070   "java:S112", // getSwagger(), addBodyExamples(), addRequestBeanParams() and getSchema() declare throws Exception because example generation and parsing surface arbitrary checked exceptions
071   "java:S115", // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., SWAGGER_paths)
072   "java:S1168", // Swagger/OpenAPI spec: null = omit field (e.g. parseList, parseMap, nullIfEmpty, toMap, firstNonEmpty)
073   "java:S1192", // Swagger schema keys read more clearly inline than as constants.
074   "java:S3776", // getSwagger() (plus merge(Schema) and addBodyExamples()) walks every Swagger section in one pass; splitting it would obscure the document structure
075   "java:S9391", // Loops populate the mutable Swagger model in document order; stream pipelines would obscure that sequencing.
076   "resource" // Resource management handled externally
077})
078public class BasicSwaggerProviderSession {
079
080   private static final RichLogger LOG = RichLogger.getLogger(BasicSwaggerProviderSession.class);
081
082   private static Set<Integer> getCodes(List<StatusCode> la, Integer def) {
083      var codes = new TreeSet<Integer>();
084      la.stream().flatMapToInt(a -> Arrays.stream(a.value())).forEach(codes::add);
085      if (codes.isEmpty() && nn(def))
086         codes.add(def);
087      return codes;
088   }
089
090   private static MarshalledMap newMap(MarshalledMap om) {
091      if (om == null)
092         return new Json5Map();
093      return om.modifiable();
094   }
095
096   private static MarshalledList nullIfEmpty(MarshalledList l) {
097      return ie(l) ? null : l;
098   }
099
100   private static MarshalledMap nullIfEmpty(MarshalledMap m) {
101      return ie(m) ? null : m;
102   }
103
104   static String joinnl(String[]...s) {
105      for (var ss : s) {
106         if (ss.length != 0)
107            return StringUtils.joinnl(ss).trim();
108      }
109      return "";
110   }
111
112   private final RestContext context;
113   private final Class<?> c;
114   private final ClassInfo rci;
115   private final FileFinder ff;
116
117   private final Messages mb;
118
119   private final VarResolverSession vr;
120   private final JsonParser jp = Json5Parser.create().ignoreUnknownBeanProperties().build();
121
122   private final JsonSchemaGeneratorSession js;
123
124   private final Locale locale;
125
126   /**
127    * Constructor.
128    *
129    * @param context The context of the REST object we're generating Swagger about.
130    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
131    * @param locale The language of the swagger we're asking for.
132    * @param ff The file finder to use for finding JSON files.
133    * @param messages The messages to use for finding localized strings.
134    * @param vr The variable resolver to use for resolving variables in the swagger.
135    * @param js The JSON-schema generator to use for stuff like examples.
136    */
137   public BasicSwaggerProviderSession(RestContext context, Locale locale, FileFinder ff, Messages messages, VarResolverSession vr, JsonSchemaGeneratorSession js) {
138      this.context = context;
139      this.c = context.getResourceClass();
140      this.rci = ClassInfo.of(c);
141      this.ff = ff;
142      this.mb = messages;
143      this.vr = vr;
144      this.js = js;
145      this.locale = locale;
146   }
147
148   /**
149    * Generates the swagger.
150    *
151    * @return A new {@link Swagger} object.
152    * @throws Exception If an error occurred producing the Swagger.
153    */
154   @SuppressWarnings({
155      "java:S6541" // Single-threaded context; synchronization unnecessary
156   })
157   public Swagger getSwagger() throws Exception {
158      // @formatter:off
159
160      var is = ff.getStream(rci.getNameSimple() + ".json", locale).orElse(null);
161
162      var ap = this.context.getMarshallingContext().getAnnotationProvider();
163
164      Predicate<String> ne = Shorts::ine;
165      Predicate<Collection<?>> nec = Shorts::ine;
166      Predicate<Map<?,?>> nem = Shorts::ine;
167
168      // Load swagger JSON from classpath.
169      var omSwagger = Json5.DEFAULT.read(is, Json5Map.class);
170      if (omSwagger == null)
171         omSwagger = new Json5Map();
172
173      // Combine it with @Rest(swagger)
174      var restAnnotations = rstream(ap.find(Rest.class, rci)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
175
176      for (var rr : restAnnotations) {
177
178         var sInfo = omSwagger.getMap("info", true);
179
180         sInfo
181            .appendIf(ne, "title",
182               firstNonEmpty(
183                  sInfo.getString("title"),
184                  resolve(rr.title())
185               )
186            )
187            .appendIf(ne, "description",
188               firstNonEmpty(
189                  sInfo.getString("description"),
190                  resolve(rr.description())
191               )
192            )
193            .appendIf(ne, "siteName",
194               firstNonEmpty(
195                  sInfo.getString("siteName"),
196                  resolve(rr.siteName())
197               )
198            );
199
200         var r = rr.swagger();
201
202         omSwagger.append(parseMap(r.value(), "@Swagger(value) on class %s", c));
203
204         if (! SwaggerAnnotation.empty(r)) {
205            var info = omSwagger.getMap("info", true);
206
207            info
208               .appendIf(ne, "title", resolve(r.title()))
209               .appendIf(ne, "description", resolve(r.description()))
210               .appendIf(ne, "version", resolve(r.version()))
211               .appendIf(ne, "termsOfService", resolve(r.termsOfService()))
212               .appendIf(nem, "contact",
213                  merge(
214                     info.getMap("contact"),
215                     toMap(r.contact())
216                  )
217               )
218               .appendIf(nem, "license",
219                  merge(
220                     info.getMap("license"),
221                     toMap(r.license())
222                  )
223               );
224         }
225
226         omSwagger
227            .appendIf(nem, "externalDocs",
228               merge(
229                  omSwagger.getMap("externalDocs"),
230                  toMap(r.externalDocs())
231               )
232            )
233            .appendIf(nec, "tags",
234               merge(
235                  omSwagger.getList("tags"),
236                  toList(r.tags())
237               )
238            );
239      }
240
241      omSwagger.appendIf(nem, "externalDocs", parseMap(mb.findFirstString("externalDocs"), "Messages/externalDocs on class %s", c));
242
243      var info = omSwagger.getMap("info", true);
244
245      info
246         .appendIf(ne, "title", resolve(mb.findFirstString("title")))
247         .appendIf(ne, "description", resolve(mb.findFirstString("description")))
248         .appendIf(ne, "version", resolve(mb.findFirstString("version")))
249         .appendIf(ne, "termsOfService", resolve(mb.findFirstString("termsOfService")))
250         .appendIf(nem, "contact", parseMap(mb.findFirstString("contact"), "Messages/contact on class %s", c))
251         .appendIf(nem, "license", parseMap(mb.findFirstString("license"), "Messages/license on class %s", c));
252
253      if (info.isEmpty())
254         omSwagger.remove("info");
255
256      var produces = omSwagger.getList("produces", true);
257      var consumes = omSwagger.getList("consumes", true);
258
259      if (consumes.isEmpty())
260         consumes.addAll(context.getConsumes());
261      if (produces.isEmpty())
262         produces.addAll(context.getProduces());
263
264      Map<String,Json5Map> tagMap = map();
265      if (omSwagger.containsKey("tags")) {
266         for (var om : omSwagger.getList("tags").elements(Json5Map.class)) {
267            String name = om.getString("name");
268            if (name == null)
269               throw new SwaggerException(null, "Tag definition found without name in swagger JSON.");
270            tagMap.put(name, om);
271         }
272      }
273
274      var s = mb.findFirstString("tags");
275      if (nn(s)) {
276         for (var m : parseListOrCdl(s, "Messages/tags on class %s", c).elements(Json5Map.class)) {
277            var name = m.getString("name");
278            if (name == null)
279               throw new SwaggerException(null, "Tag definition found without name in resource bundle on class %s", c);
280            if (tagMap.containsKey(name))
281               tagMap.get(name).putAll(m);
282            else
283               tagMap.put(name, m);
284         }
285      }
286
287      // Load our existing bean definitions into our session.
288      var definitions = omSwagger.getMap("definitions", true);
289      for (var defId : definitions.keySet())
290         js.addBeanDef(defId, new JsonMap(definitions.getMap(defId)));
291
292      // Iterate through all the @RestOp methods.
293      for (var sm : context.getRestOperations().getOpContexts()) {
294
295         var bs = sm.getMarshallingContext().getSession();
296
297         var m = sm.getJavaMethod();
298         var mi = MethodInfo.of(m);
299         var al = rstream(ap.find(mi)).filter(REST_OP_GROUP).toList();
300         var mn = m.getName();
301
302         // Honor @OpSwagger(ignore=true) — skip the operation entirely so neither the path nor the
303         // HTTP-method entry shows up in the generated spec. Done before getOperation(...) is called
304         // because that method has the side effect of inserting empty entries via computeIfAbsent.
305         var msValue = Holder.<OpSwagger>empty();
306         al.forEach(ai -> ai.getValue(OpSwagger.class, "swagger").filter(OpSwaggerAnnotation::notEmpty).ifPresent(msValue::set));
307         var ms = msValue.orElseGet(() -> OpSwaggerAnnotation.create().build());
308         if (ms.ignore())
309            continue;
310
311         // Get the operation from the existing swagger so far.
312         var op = getOperation(omSwagger, sm.getPathPattern(), lcr(sm.getHttpMethod()));
313
314         op.append(parseMap(ms.value(), "@OpSwagger(value) on class %s method %s", c, m));
315         op.appendIf(ne, "operationId",
316            firstNonEmpty(
317               resolve(ms.operationId()),
318               op.getString("operationId"),
319               mn
320            )
321         );
322
323      var summaryValue = Holder.<String>empty();
324      al.forEach(ai -> ai.getValue(String.class, "summary").filter(NOT_EMPTY).ifPresent(summaryValue::set));
325      op.appendIf(ne, "summary",
326         firstNonEmpty(
327            resolve(ms.summary()),
328            resolve(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".summary")),
329            op.getString("summary"),
330            resolve(summaryValue.orElse(null))
331         )
332      );
333
334      var descriptionValue = Holder.<String[]>empty();
335      al.forEach(ai -> ai.getValue(String[].class, "description").filter(x -> x.length > 0).ifPresent(descriptionValue::set));
336      op.appendIf(ne, "description",
337         firstNonEmpty(
338            resolve(ms.description()),
339            resolve(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".description")),
340            op.getString("description"),
341            resolve(descriptionValue.orElse(new String[0]))
342         )
343      );
344         op.appendIf(ne, "deprecated",
345            firstNonEmpty(
346               resolve(ms.deprecated()),
347               (nn(m.getAnnotation(Deprecated.class)) || nn(ClassInfo.of(m.getDeclaringClass()).getAnnotations(Deprecated.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null))) ? "true" : null
348            )
349         );
350         op.appendIf(nec, "tags",
351            merge(
352               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".tags"), "Messages/tags on class %s method %s", c, m),
353               parseListOrCdl(ms.tags(), "@OpSwagger(tags) on class %s method %s", c, m)
354            )
355         );
356         op.appendIf(nec, "schemes",
357            merge(
358               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".schemes"), "Messages/schemes on class %s method %s", c, m),
359               parseListOrCdl(ms.schemes(), "@OpSwagger(schemes) on class %s method %s", c, m)
360            )
361         );
362         op.appendIf(nec, "consumes",
363            firstNonEmpty(
364               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".consumes"), "Messages/consumes on class %s method %s", c, m),
365               parseListOrCdl(ms.consumes(), "@OpSwagger(consumes) on class %s method %s", c, m)
366            )
367         );
368         op.appendIf(nec, "produces",
369            firstNonEmpty(
370               parseListOrCdl(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".produces"), "Messages/produces on class %s method %s", c, m),
371               parseListOrCdl(ms.produces(), "@OpSwagger(produces) on class %s method %s", c, m)
372            )
373         );
374         op.appendIf(nec, "parameters",
375            merge(
376               parseList(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".parameters"), "Messages/parameters on class %s method %s", c, m),
377               parseList(ms.parameters(), "@OpSwagger(parameters) on class %s method %s", c, m)
378            )
379         );
380         op.appendIf(nem, "responses",
381            merge(
382               parseMap(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".responses"), "Messages/responses on class %s method %s", c, m),
383               parseMap(ms.responses(), "@OpSwagger(responses) on class %s method %s", c, m)
384            )
385         );
386         op.appendIf(nem, "externalDocs",
387            merge(
388               op.getMap("externalDocs"),
389               parseMap(mb.findFirstString(mn + ".externalDocs"), "Messages/externalDocs on class %s method %s", c, m),
390               toMap(ms.externalDocs())
391            )
392         );
393
394         if (op.containsKey("tags"))
395            for (var tag : op.getList("tags").elements(String.class))
396               if (! tagMap.containsKey(tag))
397                  tagMap.put(tag, Json5Map.of("name", tag));
398
399         var paramMap = new Json5Map();
400         if (op.containsKey("parameters"))
401            for (var param : op.getList("parameters").elements(Json5Map.class))
402               paramMap.put(param.getString("in") + '.' + (eq(param.getString("in"), "body") ? "body" : param.getString("name")), param);
403
404         // Finally, look for parameters defined on method.
405         for (var mpi : mi.getParameters()) {
406
407            var pt = mpi.getParameterType();
408            var type = pt.innerType();
409
410            if (ap.has(Content.class, mpi)) {
411               var param = paramMap.getMap(BODY + ".body", true).append("in", BODY);
412               var schema = getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs);
413               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
414               rstream(ap.find(Content.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner().schema()));
415               pushupSchemaFields(BODY, param, schema);
416               param.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
417               param.putIfAbsent("required", "true");
418               addBodyExamples(sm, param, false, type, locale);
419
420            } else if (ap.has(Query.class, mpi)) {
421               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Query.class, mpi).orElse(null);
422               var param = paramMap.getMap(QUERY + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", QUERY);
423               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
424               rstream(ap.find(Query.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
425               pushupSchemaFields(QUERY, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
426               addParamExample(sm, param, QUERY);
427
428            } else if (ap.has(FormData.class, mpi)) {
429               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, FormData.class, mpi).orElse(null);
430               var param = paramMap.getMap(FORM_DATA + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", FORM_DATA);
431               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
432               rstream(ap.find(FormData.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
433               pushupSchemaFields(FORM_DATA, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
434               addParamExample(sm, param, FORM_DATA);
435
436            } else if (ap.has(Header.class, mpi)) {
437               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Header.class, mpi).orElse(null);
438               var param = paramMap.getMap(HEADER + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", HEADER);
439               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
440               rstream(ap.find(Header.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
441               pushupSchemaFields(HEADER, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
442               addParamExample(sm, param, HEADER);
443
444            } else if (ap.has(Path.class, mpi)) {
445               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Path.class, mpi).orElse(null);
446               var param = paramMap.getMap(PATH + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", PATH);
447               rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner()));
448               rstream(ap.find(Path.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(param, x.inner().schema()));
449               pushupSchemaFields(PATH, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
450               addParamExample(sm, param, PATH);
451               param.putIfAbsent("required", "true");
452
453            } else if (ap.has(Request.class, mpi)) {
454               addRequestBeanParams(ap, sm, paramMap, mpi, bs);
455            }
456         }
457
458         if (! paramMap.isEmpty())
459            op.put("parameters", paramMap.values());
460
461         var responses = op.getMap("responses", true);
462
463         for (var eci : mi.getExceptionTypes()) {
464            if (eci.hasAnnotation(Response.class)) {
465               var la = rstream(ap.find(Response.class, eci)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
466               var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, eci)).map(x -> x.inner()).toList();
467               var codes = getCodes(la2, 500);
468               for (var a : la) {
469                  for (var code : codes) {
470                     var om = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true);
471                     merge(om, a);
472                     var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), m.getGenericReturnType(), bs);
473                     rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, eci)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
474                     pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
475                     om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
476               }
477            }
478            var methods = eci.getAllMethods();
479            for (var i = methods.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
480               var ecmi = methods.get(i);
481               var a = ecmi.getAnnotations(Header.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
482                  if (a == null)
483                     a = ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class).getAnnotations(Header.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
484                  if (nn(a) && ! isMulti(a)) {
485                     var ha = a.name();
486                     for (var code : codes) {
487                        var header = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true).getMap("headers", true).getMap(ha, true);
488                        rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi)).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
489                        rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class))).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
490                        pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE_HEADER, header, getSchema(header.getMap("schema"), ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class).innerType(), bs));
491                     }
492                  }
493               }
494            }
495         }
496
497         if (mi.hasAnnotation(Response.class) || mi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class).hasAnnotation(Response.class)) {
498            var la = rstream(ap.find(Response.class, mi)).map(x -> x.inner()).toList();
499            var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, mi)).map(x -> x.inner()).toList();
500            var codes = getCodes(la2, 200);
501            for (var a : la) {
502               for (var code : codes) {
503                  var om = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true);
504                  merge(om, a);
505                  var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), m.getGenericReturnType(), bs);
506                  rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
507                  pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
508                  om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
509                  addBodyExamples(sm, om, true, m.getGenericReturnType(), locale);
510               }
511         }
512         if (mi.getReturnType().hasAnnotation(Response.class)) {
513            var methods = mi.getReturnType().getAllMethods();
514            for (var i = methods.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
515               var ecmi = methods.get(i);
516                  if (ecmi.hasAnnotation(Header.class)) {
517                     var a = ecmi.getAnnotations(Header.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
518                     var ha = a.name();
519                     if (! isMulti(a)) {
520                        for (var code : codes) {
521                           var header = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true).getMap("headers", true).getMap(ha, true);
522                           rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi)).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
523                           rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, ecmi.getReturnType().unwrap(Holder.class, Optional.class))).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
524                           merge(header, a.schema());
525                           pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE_HEADER, header, getSchema(header, ecmi.getReturnType().innerType(), bs));
526                        }
527                     }
528                  }
529               }
530            }
531         } else if (m.getGenericReturnType() != void.class) {
532            var om = responses.getMap("200", true);
533            var pt2 = ClassInfo.of(m.getGenericReturnType());
534            var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), m.getGenericReturnType(), bs);
535            rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, pt2)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
536            pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
537            om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
538            addBodyExamples(sm, om, true, m.getGenericReturnType(), locale);
539         }
540
541         // Finally, look for Value @Header parameters defined on method.
542         for (var mpi : mi.getParameters()) {
543
544            var pt = mpi.getParameterType();
545
546            if (pt.is(Holder.class) && (ap.has(Header.class, mpi))) {
547               var la = rstream(ap.find(Header.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
548               var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
549               var codes = getCodes(la2, 200);
550               var name = findAnnotationName(ap, Header.class, mpi).orElse(null);
551               var type = Holder.unwrap(mpi.getParameterType().innerType());
552               for (var a : la) {
553                  if (! isMulti(a)) {
554                     for (var code : codes) {
555                        var header = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true).getMap("headers", true).getMap(name, true);
556                        rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(header, x.inner()));
557                        merge(header, a.schema());
558                        pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE_HEADER, header, getSchema(header, type, bs));
559                     }
560                  }
561               }
562
563            } else if (ap.has(Response.class, mpi)) {
564               var la = rstream(ap.find(Response.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
565               var la2 = rstream(ap.find(StatusCode.class, mpi)).map(AnnotationInfo::inner).toList();
566               var codes = getCodes(la2, 200);
567               var type = Holder.unwrap(mpi.getParameterType().innerType());
568               for (var a : la) {
569                  for (var code : codes) {
570                     var om = responses.getMap(String.valueOf(code), true);
571                     merge(om, a);
572                     var schema = getSchema(om.getMap("schema"), type, bs);
573                     rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mpi)).forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.inner()));
574                     la.forEach(x -> merge(schema, x.schema()));
575                     pushupSchemaFields(RESPONSE, om, schema);
576                     om.appendIf(nem, "schema", schema);
577                  }
578               }
579            }
580         }
581
582         // Add default response descriptions.
583         for (var e : responses.entrySet()) {
584            var key = e.getKey();
585            var val = responses.getMap(key);
586            if (isDecimal(key))
587               val.appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "description", RestUtils.getHttpResponseText(Integer.parseInt(key)));
588         }
589
590         if (responses.isEmpty())
591            op.remove("responses");
592         else
593            op.put("responses", new TreeMap<>(responses));
594
595         if (! op.containsKey("consumes")) {
596            var mConsumes = sm.getSupportedContentTypes();
597            if (! mConsumes.equals(consumes))
598               op.put("consumes", mConsumes);
599         }
600
601         if (! op.containsKey("produces")) {
602            var mProduces = sm.getSupportedAcceptTypes();
603            if (! mProduces.equals(produces))
604               op.put("produces", mProduces);
605         }
606      }
607
608      if (nn(js.getBeanDefs()))
609         for (var e : js.getBeanDefs().entrySet())
610            definitions.put(e.getKey(), fixSwaggerExtensions(renameWriteOnly(e.getValue())));
611
612      if (definitions.isEmpty())
613         omSwagger.remove("definitions");
614
615      if (! tagMap.isEmpty())
616         omSwagger.put("tags", tagMap.values());
617
618      if (consumes.isEmpty())
619         omSwagger.remove("consumes");
620      if (produces.isEmpty())
621         omSwagger.remove("produces");
622
623      try {
624         var swaggerJson = Json5R.of(omSwagger);
625         return jp.read(swaggerJson, Swagger.class);
626      } catch (Exception e) {
627         throw new ServletException("Error detected in swagger.", e);
628      }
629      // @formatter:on
630   }

632   private void addBodyExamples(RestOpContext sm, MarshalledMap piri, boolean response, Type type, Locale locale) throws Exception {
633
634      var sex = piri.getString("example");
635
636      if (sex == null) {
637         var schema = resolveRef(piri.getMap("schema"));
638         if (nn(schema))
639            sex = schema.getString("example", schema.getString("example"));
640      }
641
642      if (isEmpty(sex))
643         return;
644
645      Object example = null;
646      if (isProbablyJson(sex)) {
647         example = jp.read(sex, type);
648      } else {
649         var cm = js.getClassMeta(type);
650         if (cm.hasStringMutater()) {
651            example = BasicConverter.INSTANCE.to(sex, cm.inner());
652         }
653      }
654
655      var examplesKey = "examples";  // Parameters don't have an examples attribute.
656
657      var examples = piri.getMap(examplesKey);
658      if (examples == null)
659         examples = new Json5Map();
660
661      var mediaTypes = response ? sm.getSerializers().getSupportedMediaTypes() : sm.getParsers().getSupportedMediaTypes();
662
663      for (var mt : mediaTypes) {
664         if (mt != MediaType.HTML) {
665            var s2 = sm.getSerializers().getSerializer(mt).orElse(null);
666            if (nn(s2)) {
667               try {
668                  // @formatter:off
669                  var eVal = s2
670                     .createSession()
671                     .locale(locale)
672                     .mediaType(mt)
673                     .apply(WriterSerializerSession.Builder.class, x -> x.useWhitespace(true))
674                     .build()
675                     .writeToString(example);
676                  // @formatter:on
677                  examples.put(s2.getPrimaryMediaType().toString(), eVal);
678               } catch (Exception e) {
679                  LOG.fine("Could not serialize to media type [%s]: %s", mt, localizedMessage(e));
680               }
681            }
682         }
683      }
684
685      if (! examples.isEmpty())
686         piri.put(examplesKey, examples);
687   }

690      "java:S1172", // Parameter kept to match interface contract
691      "unused" // Eclipse: type parameter unused but kept for API consistency
692   })
693   /**
694    * Documents each annotated getter of a {@link Request @Request} bean parameter as its own part parameter, merging
695    * the getter's {@link Schema @Schema} and part-annotation {@code schema} the same way as for a plain part argument.
696    *
697    * <p>
698    * {@link Content @Content} getters are skipped: a request bean's body is documented by the bean's own schema, not
699    * by a part parameter.
700    */
701   private void addRequestBeanParams(AnnotationProvider ap, RestOpContext sm, Json5Map paramMap, ParameterInfo mpi, MarshallingSession bs) throws Exception {
702      var rbm = RequestBeanMeta.create(mpi, AnnotationWorkList.create());
703      if (rbm == null)
704         return;
705      for (var pm : rbm.getProperties()) {
706         var mi = MethodInfo.of(pm.getGetter());
707         var type = pm.getGetter().getGenericReturnType();
708         var schemas = new ArrayList<Schema>();
709         rstream(ap.find(Schema.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner()));
710         RestPartType in;
711         switch (pm.getPartType()) {
712            case QUERY -> {
713               in = QUERY;
714               rstream(ap.find(Query.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
715            }
716            case FORMDATA -> {
717               in = FORM_DATA;
718               rstream(ap.find(FormData.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
719            }
720            case HEADER -> {
721               in = HEADER;
722               rstream(ap.find(Header.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
723            }
724            case PATH -> {
725               in = PATH;
726               rstream(ap.find(Path.class, mi)).forEach(x -> schemas.add(x.inner().schema()));
727            }
728            default -> {
729               continue;
730            }
731         }
732         var name = pm.getPartName();
733         var param = paramMap.getMap(in + "." + name, true).append("name", name).append("in", in);
734         schemas.forEach(x -> merge(param, x));
735         pushupSchemaFields(in, param, getSchema(param.getMap("schema"), type, bs));
736         addParamExample(sm, param, in);
737         if (in == PATH)
738            param.putIfAbsent("required", "true");
739      }
740   }
741
742   private static void addParamExample(RestOpContext sm, MarshalledMap piri, RestPartType in) {
743
744      var s = piri.getString("example");
745
746      if (isEmpty(s))
747         return;
748
749      var examples = piri.getMap("examples");
750      if (examples == null)
751         examples = new Json5Map();
752
753      var paramName = piri.getString("name");
754
755      if (in == QUERY)
756         s = "?" + urlEncodeLax(paramName) + "=" + urlEncodeLax(s);
757      else if (in == FORM_DATA)
758         s = paramName + "=" + s;
759      else if (in == HEADER)
760         s = paramName + ": " + s;
761      else if (in == PATH)
762         s = sm.getPathPattern().replace("{" + paramName + "}", urlEncodeLax(s));
763
764      examples.put("example", s);
765
766      if (! examples.isEmpty())
767         piri.put("examples", examples);
768   }

781   private static MarshalledMap fixSwaggerExtensions(MarshalledMap om) {
782      Predicate<Object> nn = Shorts::nn;
783      // @formatter:off
784      om
785         .appendIf(nn, "discriminator", om.remove("x-discriminator"))
786         .appendIf(nn, "readOnly", om.remove("x-readOnly"))
787         .appendIf(nn, "xml", om.remove("x-xml"))
788         .appendIf(nn, "externalDocs", om.remove("x-externalDocs"))
789         .appendIf(nn, "example", om.remove("x-example"));
790      // @formatter:on
791      return nullIfEmpty(om);
792   }

801   private MarshalledMap getSchema(MarshalledMap schema, Type type, MarshallingSession bs) throws Exception {
802
803      if (type == Swagger.class)
804         return Json5Map.create();
805
806      schema = newMap(schema);
807
808      var cm = bs.getClassMeta(type);
809
810      if (schema.is("ignore", false))
811         return null;
812
813      if (schema.containsKey("type") || schema.containsKey("$ref"))
814         return schema;
815
816      return fixSwaggerExtensions(schema.append(renameWriteOnly(js.getSchema(cm))));
817   }

819   /**
820    * Swagger 2.0 has no <js>"writeOnly"</js> schema keyword, so rename the generator's flag to the <js>"x-writeOnly"</js> extension.
821    *
822    * <p>
823    * Only walks schema-keyword positions (so example/default values are untouched).  The OpenAPI 3.x provider maps the
824    * extension back to the native keyword.
825    */
826   // HTT: package-private only so a unit test can check that example/default values are not walked.
827   static <T> T renameWriteOnly(T schema) {
828      if (schema instanceof Map<?,?> m) {
829         @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
830         var m2 = (Map<String,Object>)m;
831         if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(m2.get("writeOnly"))) {
832            m2.remove("writeOnly");
833            m2.put("x-writeOnly", true);
834         }
835         for (var k : new String[]{"properties", "patternProperties", "definitions", "$defs"}) {
836            if (m2.get(k) instanceof Map<?,?> children)
837               children.values().forEach(BasicSwaggerProviderSession::renameWriteOnly);
838         }
839         for (var k : new String[]{"items", "additionalProperties", "not"})
840            renameWriteOnly(m2.get(k));
841         for (var k : new String[]{"allOf", "anyOf", "oneOf", "items"}) {
842            if (m2.get(k) instanceof List<?> l)
843               l.forEach(BasicSwaggerProviderSession::renameWriteOnly);
844         }
845      }
846      return schema;
847   }

903   private MarshalledMap merge(MarshalledMap om, Items a) throws ParseException {

906      om = newMap(om);
907      Predicate<String> ne = Shorts::ine;
908      Predicate<Collection<?>> nec = Shorts::ine;
909      Predicate<Map<?,?>> nem = Shorts::ine;
910      Predicate<Boolean> nf = ObjectUtils::isTrue;

914         .appendFirst(ne, "collectionFormat", a.collectionFormat(), a.cf())
915         .appendIf(ne, "default", joinnl(a.default_(), a.df()))
916         .appendFirst(nec, "enum", toSet(a.enum_()), toSet(a.e()))
917         .appendFirst(ne, "format", a.format(), a.f())
918         .appendIf(nf, "exclusiveMaximum", a.exclusiveMaximum() || a.emax())
919         .appendIf(nf, "exclusiveMinimum", a.exclusiveMinimum() || a.emin())
920         .appendIf(nem, "items", merge(om.getMap("items"), a.items()))
921         .appendFirst(ne, "maximum", a.maximum(), a.max())
922         .appendFirst(nm1, "maxItems", a.maxItems(), a.maxi())
923         .appendFirst(nm1, "maxLength", a.maxLength(), a.maxl())

925         .appendFirst(nm1, "minItems", a.minItems(), a.mini())
926         .appendFirst(nm1, "minLength", a.minLength(), a.minl())
927         .appendFirst(ne, "multipleOf", a.multipleOf(), a.mo())
928         .appendFirst(ne, "pattern", a.pattern(), a.p())
929         .appendIf(nf, "uniqueItems", a.uniqueItems() || a.ui())
930         .appendFirst(ne, "type", a.type(), a.t())
931         .appendIf(ne, "$ref", a.$ref())

952   private MarshalledMap merge(MarshalledMap om, Schema a) {
953      try {
954         if (SchemaAnnotation.empty(a))
955            return om;
956         om = newMap(om);
957         Predicate<String> ne = Shorts::ine;
958         Predicate<Collection<?>> nec = Shorts::ine;

964            .appendIf(ne, "allOf", joinnl(a.allOf()))
965            .appendFirst(ne, "collectionFormat", a.collectionFormat(), a.cf())
966            .appendIf(ne, "default", joinnl(a.default_(), a.df()))
967            .appendIf(ne, "discriminator", a.discriminator())
968            .appendIf(ne, "description", resolve(a.description(), a.d()))
969            .appendFirst(nec, "enum", toSet(a.enum_()), toSet(a.e()))
970            .appendIf(nf, "exclusiveMaximum", a.emax())
971            .appendIf(nf, "exclusiveMinimum", a.emin())
972            .appendIf(nem, "externalDocs", merge(om.getMap("externalDocs"), a.externalDocs()))
973            .appendFirst(ne, "format", a.format(), a.f())
974            .appendIf(ne, "ignore", a.ignore() ? "true" : null)
975            .appendIf(nem, "items", merge(om.getMap("items"), a.items()))
976            .appendFirst(ne, "maximum", a.maximum(), a.max())

979            .appendFirst(nm1, "maxProperties", a.maxProperties(), a.maxp())
980            .appendFirst(ne, "minimum", a.minimum(), a.min())

982            .appendFirst(nm1, "minLength", a.minLength(), a.minl())
983            .appendFirst(nm1, "minProperties", a.minProperties(), a.minp())

991            .appendIf(nf, "uniqueItems", a.uniqueItems() || a.ui())
992            .appendIf(ne, "xml", joinnl(a.xml()))

1032   private MarshalledList parseList(Object o, String location, Object...locationArgs) throws ParseException {
1033      try {
1034         if (o == null)
1035            return null;
1036         var s = (o instanceof String[] o2 ? joinnl(o2) : o.toString());
1037         if (s.isEmpty())
1038            return null;
1039         s = resolve(s);
1040         if (! isProbablyJsonArray(s, true))
1041            s = "[" + s + "]";
1042         return Json5List.ofString(s);
1043      } catch (ParseException e) {
1044         throw new SwaggerException(e, "Malformed swagger JSON array encountered in " + location + ".", locationArgs);
1045      }
1046   }

1062   private MarshalledMap parseMap(Object o) throws ParseException {
1063      if (o == null)
1064         return null;
1065      if (o instanceof String[] o2)
1066         o = joinnl(o2);
1067      if (o instanceof String o2) {
1068         if (o2.isEmpty())
1069            return null;
1070         o2 = resolve(o2);
1071         if (eqic("IGNORE", o2))
1072            return Json5Map.of("ignore", true);
1073         if (! isProbablyJsonObject(o2, true))
1074            o2 = "{" + o2 + "}";
1075         return Json5Map.ofString(o2);
1076      }
1077      if (o instanceof Json5Map o2)
1078         return o2;
1079      if (o instanceof MarshalledMap o2)
1080         return new Json5Map(o2);
1081      throw new SwaggerException(null, "Unexpected data type '%s'.  Expected Map or String.", cn(o));
1082   }

1084   private MarshalledMap parseMap(String o, String location, Object...args) throws ParseException {
1085      try {
1086         return parseMap(o);
1087      } catch (ParseException e) {
1088         throw new SwaggerException(e, "Malformed swagger JSON object encountered in " + location + ".", args);
1089      }
1090   }

1092   private MarshalledMap parseMap(String[] o, String location, Object...args) throws ParseException {
1093      if (o.length == 0)

1095      try {
1096         return parseMap(o);
1097      } catch (ParseException e) {
1098         throw new SwaggerException(e, "Malformed swagger JSON object encountered in " + location + ".", args);

1102   private static MarshalledMap pushupSchemaFields(RestPartType type, MarshalledMap param, MarshalledMap schema) {
1103      // @formatter:off
1104      Predicate<Object> ne = Shorts::ine;
1105      if (nn(schema) && ! schema.isEmpty()) {
1106         if (type == BODY || type == RESPONSE) {
1107            param
1108               .appendIf(ne, "description", schema.remove("description"));
1109         } else {
1110            param
1111               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "collectionFormat", schema.remove("collectionFormat"))
1112               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "default", schema.remove("default"))
1113               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "description", schema.remove("description"))
1114               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "enum", schema.remove("enum"))
1115               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "example", schema.remove("example"))
1116               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "exclusiveMaximum", schema.remove("exclusiveMaximum"))
1117               .appendIfAbsentIf(ne, "exclusiveMinimum", schema.remove("exclusiveMinimum"))

1262   private static Optional<String> findAnnotationName(AnnotationProvider ap, Class<? extends java.lang.annotation.Annotation> type, ParameterInfo pi) {
